profile.headline: Software Engineer | .NET, Docker, React, SQL | Engineering Solutions Through Collaboration
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Well practiced in web and desktop development utilizing .Net, Java, React, SQL databases, as well as CRM and ERP administration.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: In this role, I played a key role in integrating product engineering, sales and marketing, accounting, and logistics into a single, unified ERP system. Working closely with stakeholders across departments, I translated complex business needs into software design and delivered high-quality, maintainable code in an Agile team environment. My expertise in ERP systems and deep understanding of Java programming enabled me to create a robust and efficient solution that optimized operational efficiency and improved customer satisfaction. Through my dedication to excellence, I successfully accomplished the integration of disparate systems and processes into a unified platform, resulting in increased revenue and improved business outcomes.
